MCP tool schemas and example outputs

Source: vignettes/mcp-tool-schemas.qmd

This vignette shows what an MCP client can expose to an AI agent when the rairai server is used against this package. It prints all 21 current tool schemas and representative inputs. The 19 package-local examples run during rendering; the two CRAN examples show schemas and inputs only, without network calls or fabricated responses.

Schemas and local responses come from freshly loaded package code, not hand-written snapshots. Example arguments are maintained here. Displayed JSON replaces the canonical build root with /path/to/rairai, including occurrences in nested values or keys. This is a publication-only redaction: runtime responses still disclose canonical absolute host paths. Source-relative locations are unchanged.

How to read this vignette

Each section below is produced from the live tool definitions in this package:

  • The schema comes from the mcplite::tool() object after conversion to MCP tool JSON for protocol version 2025-11-25.
  • The example input is a small argument list chosen to exercise the tool against this repository.
  • Each local response is produced by calling the tool during rendering. A failed call fails the render instead of being presented as a normal response.
  • CRAN inputs are illustrative and are not executed.

Loading rairai here runs the documentation generator. The tools inspect package files and metadata statically; they do not execute inspected source to obtain facts. The 19 local schemas expose optional package_root; the CRAN schemas do not. See the toolset overview for root selection and filesystem access.

emit_tool_group(
  "Static package tools",
  c(
    "package_overview",
    "package_dependencies",
    "package_files",
    "package_namespace",
    "tests_for",
    "package_docs",
    "help_search",
    "help_page",
    "package_vignettes",
    "package_news"
  )
)

Static package tools

package_overview

Get a compact orientation map of the local package, including metadata, namespace, file layout, docs, tests, and source objects.

Schema visible to the MCP client 

{
  "name": "package_overview",
  "description": "Get a compact orientation map of the local package, including metadata, namespace, file layout, docs, tests, and source objects.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "package_root": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Absolute path to the target package root."
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}

Example input 

{}

package_dependencies

Read dependency fields from DESCRIPTION.

Schema visible to the MCP client 

{
  "name": "package_dependencies",
  "description": "Read dependency fields from DESCRIPTION.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "depth": {
        "type": "integer",
        "description": "Dependency depth. Use 1 for direct dependencies only. Default: 1."
      },
      "package_root": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Absolute path to the target package root."
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}

{
  "depth": 1
}

package_namespace

Read exports, imports, S3 registrations, and native-code declarations from NAMESPACE. Imported object lists are compact by default.

Schema visible to the MCP client 

{
  "name": "package_namespace",
  "description": "Read exports, imports, S3 registrations, and native-code declarations from NAMESPACE. Imported object lists are compact by default.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "package": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Imported package to inspect in full, such as 'dplyr' or 'stringr'. Leave empty for the namespace summary."
      },
      "package_root": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Absolute path to the target package root."
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}

{}

tests_for

Find test files and test blocks that reference a symbol. Use this before changing behavior to locate related tests.

Schema visible to the MCP client 

{
  "name": "tests_for",
  "description": "Find test files and test blocks that reference a symbol. Use this before changing behavior to locate related tests.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "name": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Symbol name to search for in tests."
      },
      "package_root": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Absolute path to the target package root."
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "name"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}

package_docs

Summarize package documentation, including help pages, aliases, titles, vignettes, and NEWS.

Schema visible to the MCP client 

{
  "name": "package_docs",
  "description": "Summarize package documentation, including help pages, aliases, titles, vignettes, and NEWS.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "package": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Package to inspect. Leave empty for the local source package."
      },
      "limit": {
        "type": "integer",
        "description": "Maximum number of help topics."
      },
      "offset": {
        "type": "integer",
        "description": "Number of help topics to skip."
      },
      "package_root": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Absolute path to the target package root."
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
}

Example input 

{
  "package": "rairai",
  "limit": 10
}

Example response 

{
  "package_root": "/path/to/rairai",
  "package": "rairai",
  "source": "local",
  "help": {
    "total_count": 4,
    "count": 4,

Example response 

{
  "package_root": "/path/to/rairai",
  "class": "PackageToolService",
  "method": "symbols",
  "section": "public",
  "signature": "symbols(query = NULL, path = NULL, kind = NULL, exact = TRUE, limit = 50L)",
  "source": "symbols = function(\n      query = NULL,\n      path = NULL,\n      kind = NULL,\n      exact = TRUE,\n      limit = 50L\n    ) {\n      query <- normalize_optional_string(query, default = NULL)\n      path <- normalize_optional_string(path, default = NULL)\n      kind <- normalize_optional_string(kind, default = NULL)\n      if (identical(str_to_lower(kind %||% \"\"), \"all\")) {\n        kind <- NULL\n      }\n      exact <- normalize_logical_value(exact, default = TRUE)\n      limit <- normalize_limit_value(limit, default = 50L)\n\n      result <- self$source_index$symbols(\n        query = query,\n        path = path,\n        kind = kind,\n        exact = exact,\n        limit = limit\n      )\n      if (has_tool_error(result)) {\n        return(tool_error_response(error = result$error))\n      }\n\n      response_symbols <- compact_location_records(\n        result$symbols,\n        include_leading_comment = TRUE,\n        source_root = self$root_path\n      )\n      response <- list(\n        query = result$query,\n        status = result$status,\n        exact = exact,\n        filters = result$filters,\n        count = length(response_symbols),\n        total_count = result$total_count,\n        truncated = result$truncated,\n        limit = result$limit,\n        symbols = response_symbols\n      )\n      if (!is.null(result$path)) {\n        response$path <- result$path\n      }\n      if (length(result$parse_errors %||% list()) > 0L) {\n        response$parse_errors <- result$parse_errors\n      }\n      if (identical(result$status, \"none\")) {\n        response$next_tools <- private$symbols_no_match_next_tools(\n          query = query,\n          exact = exact\n        )\n      }\n\n      tool_value_response(!!!response)\n    }",
  "location": "R/tool-service.R:108-165"
}

symbols
